The original aa75-run red's cause is the same by teeth match, not by observation of what ran beside it. 2026-11-19 on akiendell (Windows): alone, 10 of 10 runs green (76-102 s); inside aa750de17382's moved-proofs tooth 1 red of 4 (the first; teeth e_blocks_unearned_consolidated_sources and the consolidation-links tooth) then 3 green; Linux (akienasus_cc_0) 40 of 40 green. Observed after the runs, not attributed and not to be deleted here: cairn_nodes 521, cairn_embeddings 476, cairn_links 9, oldest node 2026-10-28.
